title: Photography Portfolio
tagline: Interactive photography portfolio with a split-panel album design and flipbook-style image browsing.
description: This is a modern, interactive photography portfolio showcasing albums with an elegant split-panel design and flipbook-style image browsing. It features dynamic hero images, fullscreen lightboxes, and a responsive layout with unique color themes and glass morphism effects, all built with HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript.
features: Split-Panel Navigation: Hover-expanding panels for album selection
Hero Image Rotator: Dynamic hero images with crossfade transitions
Flipbook Display: Magazine-style photo spreads with smooth pagination
Fullscreen Lightbox: Click any image for immersive fullscreen preview
Responsive Design: Mobile-friendly layouts adapting to all screen sizes
Color Themes: Each album has its own accent color
Glass Morphism: Frosted glass effects on navigation and overlays

overrides.tagline: Interactive photography portfolio with a split-panel album design and flipbook-style image browsing.
